AR.name: Lampazo
AR.citation: humanidadadondevas.com.ar plant-medicine reference: 'presente en Uruguay, Chile (V a X region) y en Argentina desde Entre Rios y Santa Fe hasta Chubut', documenting real naturalized distribution and traditional preparation (root decoction) for depurative/diuretic use. Corroborated by real first-person usage testimony from Salta, Argentina on a separate gardening blog, and by SIB (Argentina's official Parques Nacionales service), which uses the same 'lampazo/bardana' naming convention for the closely related Arctium minus.
